description: Lease identification, lessee schedules, modifications, lessor, sale and leaseback and disclosures, with paragraph citations. Demo and educational use only. No liability assumed for results. Not professional advice.

tools.name: agent_about
tools.title: IFRS 16 Lease Accounting Agent: what this agent covers
tools.description: Lists the standards and tools in this agent, the order to use them in, and the terms of use.

tools.name: ifrs16_lease_identification
tools.title: IFRS 16: Is it a lease? Exemptions (5-11, B9-B31)
tools.description: Applies the IFRS 16 definition of a lease (identified asset without a substantive substitution right; right to obtain substantially all economic benefits; right to direct how and for what purpose the asset is used, or predetermined decisions with the customer operating or having designed it) and the short-term and low-value recognition exemptions (5-8, B3-B8).

identifiedAsset.description: An asset is explicitly or implicitly specified (or a physically distinct / substantially all capacity portion) [IFRS 16.B13, IFRS 16.B20]

substantiveSubstitutionRight.description: Supplier has a substantive substitution right (practical ability and economic benefit) [IFRS 16.B14, IFRS 16.B15]

substantiallyAllEconomicBenefits.description: Customer obtains substantially all the economic benefits from use [IFRS 16.B21]

customerDirectsHowAndWhy.description: Customer directs how and for what purpose the asset is used [IFRS 16.B24, IFRS 16.B25]

decisionsPredeterminedAndCustomerOperate.description: Decisions predetermined, and the customer operates or designed the asset [IFRS 16.B24(b)]

underlyingValueWhenNew.description: Value of the underlying asset when new [IFRS 16.B3, IFRS 16.B4]

tools.name: ifrs16_lessee_measurement
tools.title: IFRS 16: Lessee: lease liability, ROU asset & schedule (22-38)
tools.description: Measures a lessee's lease liability at commencement (present value of fixed payments, expected residual value guarantee amounts and a purchase option reasonably certain to be exercised, at the implicit rate or incremental borrowing rate) and the right-of-use asset (liability + prepayments − incentives + initial direct costs + restoration), then builds the liability amortisation, depreciation and annual profit or loss compared with straight-line rent.

endDate.description: End of lease term (incl. reasonably certain options) [IFRS 16.18, IFRS 16.19]

timing.description: Payment timing Options: advance (In advance); arrears (In arrears)

discountRate.description: Rate implicit in the lease or incremental borrowing rate (annual, decimal) [IFRS 16.26]

residualValueGuaranteeExpected.description: Amount expected to be payable under a residual value guarantee (at end) [IFRS 16.27(c)]

purchaseOptionPriceReasonablyCertain.description: Purchase option price, if reasonably certain to be exercised (at end) [IFRS 16.27(d)]

paymentsBeforeCommencement.description: Lease payments made at or before commencement (not in the schedule) [IFRS 16.24(b)]

usefulLifeYears.description: Useful life if ownership transfers or purchase option reasonably certain (years; 0 = use lease term) [IFRS 16.32]

tools.name: ifrs16_remeasurement_and_modification
tools.title: IFRS 16: Lessee: reassessment & modifications (39-46)
tools.description: Remeasures a lease liability for a reassessment (index or rate change at the unchanged rate; change in lease term or purchase option at a revised rate) or a modification (separate lease; decrease in scope with proportionate derecognition of the right-of-use asset and a gain or loss; other modifications adjusting the right-of-use asset at a revised rate), with the journal.

event.description: Event [IFRS 16.39, IFRS 16.44, IFRS 16.45, IFRS 16.46] Options: index_or_rate_change (Reassessment: change in index or rate (unchanged discount rate)); term_or_option_change (Reassessment: change in lease term or purchase option (revised rate)); modification_separate_lease (Modification: separate lease (added asset at stand-alone price)); modification_decrease_scope (Modification: decrease in scope); modification_other (Modification: other (e.g. term extension, price change))

liabilityCarrying.description: Lease liability carrying amount before the event

rouCarrying.description: Right-of-use asset carrying amount before the event

revisedRate.description: Revised discount rate at effective date (decimal) [IFRS 16.40, IFRS 16.45]

timing.description: Timing Options: advance (In advance); arrears (In arrears)

tools.name: ifrs16_lessor
tools.title: IFRS 16: Lessor: classification & accounting (61-88)
tools.description: Classifies a lease for the lessor using the IFRS 16.63 indicators (ownership transfer, bargain purchase option, major part of economic life, present value of lease payments substantially all of fair value, specialised asset), solving the rate implicit in the lease. For a finance lease, computes the net investment and year-one finance income; for an operating lease, straight-line lease income.

timing.description: Timing Options: advance (In advance); arrears (In arrears)

fairValueOfAsset.description: Fair value of the underlying asset at commencement

guaranteedResidual.description: Residual value guaranteed (by lessee or third party) [IFRS 16.70(c)]

ownershipTransfers.description: Ownership transfers by the end of the lease term [IFRS 16.63(a)]

bargainPurchaseOption.description: Purchase option priced well below expected fair value [IFRS 16.63(b)]

specialisedAsset.description: Asset is so specialised only the lessee can use it without major modification [IFRS 16.63(e)]

tools.name: ifrs16_sale_and_leaseback
tools.title: IFRS 16: Sale and leaseback: seller-lessee (98-103)
tools.description: Accounts for a sale and leaseback by the seller-lessee: if the transfer is a sale under IFRS 15, adjusts off-market terms (sale price above fair value as additional financing, below as a prepayment), measures the right-of-use asset as the proportion of the previous carrying amount relating to the right of use retained, and recognises only the gain on the rights transferred (100-101). Otherwise treats the proceeds as a financial liability (103). Notes the 102A subsequent-measurement requirement.

transferIsSale.description: Transfer satisfies IFRS 15 requirements to be a sale [IFRS 16.99, IFRS 16.103]

timing.description: Leaseback payment timing Options: arrears (In arrears); advance (In advance)

tools.name: ifrs16_disclosure_checklist
tools.title: IFRS 16: Disclosure checklist (51-60, 89-97)
tools.description: Generates the tailored IFRS 16 disclosure checklist for lessees (51-60) and lessors (89-97).

tools.name: ifrs16_lookup
tools.title: IFRS 16: Paragraph & topic lookup
tools.description: Searches the IFRS 16 knowledge base by paragraph number or keywords and returns paraphrased requirements with paragraph citations, so answers can be grounded and cited.

tools.name: ifrs16_transition
tools.title: IFRS 16: Lessee transition: modified retrospective options (C5-C10)
tools.description: For a former operating lease with level annual payments in arrears, measures the lease liability at the date of initial application (remaining payments at the incremental borrowing rate) and compares the two right-of-use asset options: equal to the liability adjusted for prepaid or accrued payments (no equity effect) or the carrying amount as if IFRS 16 had always applied, discounted at the rate at initial application (difference to opening retained earnings, shown before and after tax).

annualPayment.description: Annual lease payment (paid at year end) [IFRS 16.27]

yearsElapsedAtInitialApplication.description: Years elapsed at the date of initial application

incrementalBorrowingRate.description: Incremental borrowing rate at the date of initial application [IFRS 16.C8(a)]

prepaidLessAccrued.description: Prepaid (positive) or accrued (negative) lease payments at transition [IFRS 16.C8(b)(ii)]

taxRate.description: Tax rate for the deferred tax effect [IAS 12.22A]

tools.name: ifrs16_sublease
tools.title: IFRS 16: Sublease classification and intermediate lessor accounting (B58, 68)
tools.description: Classifies a sublease by reference to the right-of-use asset from the head lease (operating if the head lease uses the short-term exemption; otherwise finance when the sublease covers the major part of the remaining right-of-use term, using a threshold you set as an indicator), and for a finance sublease derecognises the right-of-use asset, recognises the net investment and the gain or loss, while the head lease liability remains.

headLeaseShortTermExempt.description: Head lease accounted for under the short-term exemption [IFRS 16.B58(a)]

headLeaseRemainingYears.description: Remaining term of the head lease (years)

rightOfUseCarrying.description: Carrying amount of the right-of-use asset subleased

pvSubleasePayments.description: Present value of sublease payments (rate implicit in the sublease) [IFRS 16.68]

majorPartThreshold.description: Indicator threshold for the major part of the remaining term [IFRS 16.63(c)]
